given.note: event-sensitive-no-initials.json with one fault: the sensitive event carries 张.伟., one Chinese character and a dot per name part, for the client named 张伟. Refused: a Chinese character is a whole syllable or word, so these initials spell the whole name onto Maya's calendar; a letter of Han, Hangul, Hiragana, Katakana or Yi is never an initial, and a name that gives none is written as 'Visit' alone (RULES 4.6: 'only the display name, times and initials'; S13-22; arch 05 line 267; RULES 4.5: 'When unsure, treat it as private').
